models.Current model: The unchanged v3 ranking, including role-specific and adaptive defensive weights.
models.League z-score: Equal feature weights on league-standardized raw v3 inputs; no regression or percentile blend.
models.Per-36 baseline: Equal-weight league z-scores; points, assists, turnovers, steals, and blocks use per-36 rates.
models.Per-100 possessions: Equal-weight league z-scores; counting features use official season totals / on-court possessions × 100. No pace approximation.
models.Fixed components: The v3 profiles and within-component role weights, with defense fixed at 25%.
models.Covariance adjusted: Mahalanobis distance on v3 profiles. Separate Ledoit–Wolf covariance estimates per league are averaged before inversion; no v3 feature weights.
models.Hellinger shooting: V3 outside shooting. Four location shares are one Hellinger distribution distance with 80% of the shooting budget; FTA/FGA retains 20%. This changes the block scale as well as geometry.
models.Game-rate baseline: Equal-weight league z-scores of six per-36 counts, true shooting, 3PA/FGA, and FTA/FGA, aggregated from game logs. This is the bootstrap model.
models.Without offensive production: V3 with offensive production removed; remaining pair weights renormalized.
models.Without shot selection: V3 with shot selection removed; remaining pair weights renormalized.
models.Without efficiency: V3 with efficiency removed; remaining pair weights renormalized.
models.Without defense: V3 with defense removed; remaining pair weights renormalized.

interpretation: Model agreement is not accuracy. Human evaluation remains pending.
